QuestInfo.name: Nella's Proposal
QuestInfo.0: Nella in Kerning City wants to see you. Alone.
QuestInfo.1: Nella wants you to hunt Jr. Wraiths and gather up their Tablecloths. These tablecloth-wearing fiends hang out in the #rSubway #m103020200##k and in #r#m103020300##k.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought Nella the tablecloths she ordered.

0.0: Hi there! Name's #bNella#k. If you're looking for information, you've come to the right person.
0.1: Or are you looking for a job? I know you're working with JM, but if you work with ME, instead, I'll take a smaller cut from your commission. What about it? Interested?

yes.0: You're smarter than you look! Okay, I've already got a job lined up for you. #bEliminate 150 Jr. Wraiths#k in the Subway #m103020200# and #m103020300#, and bring me #b50 Tablecloths#k.
yes.1: This is a real job. Not like that weird things JM sends you to do.

no.0: Sure. If you want JM to keep ripping you off, be my guest.

1.0: That was fast! Keep this up, and you'll go far. Anyway, you did the job, so you get the pay!

yes.0: I know where to find you next time I have a job for you.

item.0: I need those 50 Tablecloths. Get them back to me ASAP.

mob.0: The job's not finished until you eliminate 150 Jr. Wraiths, you know.
